announcement.text: Use our free scanner to check your security!

hero.title: Cybersecurity with AI‑assisted pentesting.
hero.body: We use Europe's top pentesters to make organizations digitally resilient. Through advanced testing and red teaming, we expose vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them.
hero.dashboardAlt: AssistSec portal showing API security findings

platform.poweredBy: Powered by innovation and next-generation artificial intelligence
platform.lead: We combine the expertise of Europe's most experienced pentesters to make organizations digitally resilient. Through advanced agentic pentesting we proactively expose vulnerabilities before malicious actors can exploit them.

agents.title:
Autonomous agents
for the test work.
agents.subtitle: Senior security experts oversee every finding.

pentesting.title: Pentesting
pentesting.body: Web application and API pentesting, our autonomous AI agents perform blackbox and greybox pentests.

cloud.title: Monthly continuous pentesting
cloud.body: After an initial pentest, you can opt for monthly continuous pentesting. This lets us track each month whether things are improving or not, and we retest all findings on request.

redTeaming.title: Continuous compliance
redTeaming.body: Alongside the initial pentest and monthly continuous pentesting, we map every finding to the relevant ISO 27001 controls. This gives your organization one clear, unified view of its current compliance posture.

alt.pentesting: Threat coverage view in the AssistSec portal
alt.cloud: Overall security score view in the AssistSec portal
alt.redTeaming: Cloud and identity provider coverage in the AssistSec portal

experts.title: AI + experts
experts.body: Officers do the heavy lifting. Every finding is validated.

insight.title: Immediate insight
insight.body: Critical findings live in your portal. No waiting for the report.

benefits.title: An assistsec report.
benefits.reportIntro: The findings are included in a final report, including a clear management summary.
benefits.reportBody: Vulnerabilities are evaluated and provided with recommendations, prioritized based on risk.

modal.title: Request a sample report
modal.description: See exactly what an AssistSec pentest report looks like. Leave your details and we'll send a sample straight to your inbox.
modal.successBody: Your request has been received. We'll send the sample report to your inbox shortly.
